title: 上部 凡尘问道 第15章 苏晚晴梦境与羁绊上部 凡尘问道 第16章 外门赛连环破招
content_zh:
第1节异端罪诏下，三日内问斩
亥时的梆子声刚响，外门居所的木门就被撞得粉碎。柳岳带着四名内门弟子闯进来，玄色道袍上的“执法”二字在烛火下泛着冷光。
“凌无妄，速速交出苏晚晴！”柳岳手持鎏金令牌，声音如冰，“她私传禁术、煽动功法开源，犯了道院‘异端重罪’，现已被缉拿，三日后午时宗门广场公开问斩！”
凌无妄猛地起身，挡在凌母和凌小妹身前，规则之眼瞬间运转【检测到柳岳灵力波动筑基初期。执法弟子炼气后期x4。令牌为“天道代行者”亲授，可直接判定异端，先斩后奏】
“苏晚晴只是分享修炼心得，何谈异端？”凌无妄攥紧拳头，“分明是你公报私仇！”
“公报私仇？”柳岳嗤笑，抬手甩出一卷宗门禁地卷宗，“**《原初天道录》明确记载‘功法闭源为天规’，她偏要主张开源共享，这就是篡改天道！”
卷宗摔在地上，首页“闭源者生，开源者死”八个朱字刺目。凌母吓得浑身发抖，凌小妹紧紧抓住凌无妄的衣角“无妄哥，苏姐姐是好人，我们不能让她死！”
系统面板弹出猩红提示【苏晚晴生存倒计时71时辰58分。审判规则异端罪可直接剥夺修为、抽取道果，用于滋养天道钱庄闭源体系】
【触发支线任务营救苏晚晴。任务奖励解锁神血与玉佩共鸣权限。失败惩罚原初规则载体陨落，天道纠错任务进度清零】
“柳岳，你敢动她试试！”凌无妄运转灵力，指尖泛起淡金光晕，“藏书阁偷**的是我，煽动开源的也是我，与她无关！”
“哦？”柳岳眼中闪过一丝阴狠，“正好，你这无灵根的破法者，本就该和她一起受死。不过现在，我要找的是苏晚晴的同党——据说她藏了半卷《原初天道录》手抄本。”
他挥了挥手，内门弟子立刻围上来“搜！仔细搜，找不到手抄本，就把这老弱病残带去天牢拷问！”
凌无妄侧身挡在门前，规则之眼已看穿四名弟子的功法弱点“想动我的人，先过我这关！”
第2节天牢夜探监，血梦藏秘辛
柳岳一行人搜遍居所无果，悻悻离去。凌无妄安顿好家人，立刻借着夜色潜入宗门天牢。
天牢由黑纹玄铁铸就，墙体刻满“锁灵符文”，每走一步都能感受到灵力被压制。凌无妄运转规则之眼，很快找到符文循环的断点，指尖注入高频灵力，符文瞬间黯淡。
【检测到天牢禁制规则每炷香符文能量循环一次，断点持续5息。东南角守卫换班间隙，是唯一探视窗口】
他猫着腰躲在石柱后，等换班的守卫走远，立刻冲到苏晚晴所在的牢房前。铁栏后，苏晚晴被铁链锁住琵琶骨，鲜血浸透了白色道袍，却依旧脊背挺直。
“无妄，你怎么来了？”苏晚晴眼中闪过惊喜，随即转为担忧，“柳岳故意放风让你知道，就是为了引你现身！”
“我知道。”凌无妄握住冰冷的铁栏，“三日后的审判，我一定救你出去。你藏的手抄本呢？柳岳正在找它。”

苏晚晴苦笑一声，吐出一口血沫“手抄本在我身上，但他们搜不出来。这不是普通的书，是用我的血写的，只有破法者的气息能激活。”
她凑近铁栏，声音压得极低“我总做一个重复的梦——三岁那年，我在乱葬岗快饿死时，一滴金色的血滴进我嘴里，救了我的命。那血里有和你规则之眼一样的符文，还刻着‘开源’二字。”
凌无妄心头一震，想起老乞丐说的“神血化玉”，难道苏晚晴体内的就是第七执笔者的神血？
“还有这卷手抄本。”苏晚晴从领口掏出一块贴身藏着的兽皮卷，透过铁栏递给他，“这是我从内门藏书阁偷抄的，上面写着‘第七执笔者自斩神格，神血化玉，遇有缘人则醒，遇篡改者则怒’。”
就在这时，远处传来脚步声。苏晚晴急忙道“你快走吧！柳岳在牢外布了‘引灵阵’，只要你动用破法能力，就会被锁定位置！”
凌无妄刚要转身，两名守卫已出现在拐角“有人闯牢！拿下他！”
第3节残卷藏密钥，锁神阵杀机
凌无妄侧身躲过守卫的刀砍，指尖点中对方丹田的能量淤积点，守卫当场瘫倒。他趁机冲出天牢，身后传来柳岳的怒吼“凌无妄，你跑不掉的！三日后的审判，我会让你亲眼看着苏晚晴被抽出道果！”
回到居所，凌无妄迫不及待地展开兽皮卷。规则之眼运转到极致，原本模糊的字迹渐渐清晰，除了苏晚晴提到的内容，末尾还有一行被血渍覆盖的小字“神血为引，玉佩为钥，二者共鸣，可窥原初天道。”
【检测到核心线索苏晚晴体内的神血是激活玉佩的关键，手抄本记载的“开源心法”可暂时屏蔽闭源规则压制】
【警告！检测到宗门广场审判现场已布下“锁神阵”，该阵法专为克制破法者设计，可封锁规则类能力，持续运转将抽取目标灵力】
凌无妄握紧兽皮卷，心中已有计划。他必须在三日内掌握开源心法，破解锁神阵，救出苏晚晴。
“无妄哥，我能帮你。”凌小妹端来一碗热水，眼神坚定，“我之前在杂役营听老人们说，锁神阵的阵眼在广场中央的旗杆下，需要用反向灵力才能破坏。”
凌无妄点点头，将兽皮卷递给她“你帮我照看娘，我现在就去修炼开源心法。三日后午时，我们里应外合。”
他刚要起身，孟春突然推门进来，脸上带着焦急“凌兄弟，不好了！柳岳为了防止你救人，不仅加派了守卫，还请来了天道钱庄的李管事坐镇审判现场！”
凌无妄心中一凛。李管事是筑基期修为，还精通幻灵术，有他在，救人的难度陡增。但他没有退缩，反而眼神更亮“来得正好，我倒要看看，闭源规则能不能挡住开源之力。”
他盘膝坐下，按照兽皮卷上的开源心法运转灵力。与道院的闭源功法不同，开源心法讲究灵力共享、循环共生，运转时竟能吸收周围的天地灵气，速度是极简引气法的三倍。
【检测到主角修炼开源心法，灵力突破至引气后期。规则之眼进化可短暂屏蔽闭源规则压制，但每次使用消耗1年阳寿】
三日后清晨，凌无妄睁开眼睛，周身灵力澎湃。他将兽皮卷藏在怀中，对凌母和凌小妹道“娘，小妹，等我回来。”
凌母拉住他，塞给他一枚平安符“一定要小心，实在不行就跑，娘和小妹等你。”

凌无妄点点头，转身走出居所。宗门广场的方向已传来敲锣声，审判即将开始。他知道，这不仅是一场营救，更是开源与闭源的首次正面交锋，成败在此一举。
而他不知道的是，兽皮卷的夹层里，还藏着一张极小的纸条，上面是苏晚晴用鲜血写的字“我梦到你我皆为原初天道碎片，合则生，离则死。”
系统面板弹出最终提示【审判现场危机等级级。李管事已布下双重陷阱锁神阵+幻灵杀阵。苏晚晴体内神血已被天道钱庄标记，抽取道果可激活墨规子的部分闭源力量】
content_en:
Section 1: Under the edict for heresy, beheaded within three days
As soon as the bang of Haishi sounded, the wooden door of the outer residence was smashed into pieces. Liu Yue came in with four inner disciples. The word "law enforcement" on the black robe shone coldly under the candlelight.
"Ling Wuwang, hand over Su Wanqing quickly!" Liu Yue held the gilded token and said in a voice as cold as ice, "She secretly taught forbidden techniques and instigated the practice of martial arts to be open to the public. She committed a 'heretical crime' in the Taoist temple. She has been arrested and will be publicly interrogated and executed in the Zongmen Square at noon three days later!"
Ling Wuwang stood up suddenly and stood in front of Ling's mother and Ling Xiaomei. The Eye of Rules instantly activated [Detected Liu Yue's spiritual power fluctuation in the early stage of foundation building. Law Enforcement Disciple Qi Refining Late Stage x4. The token is personally given by the "Agent of Heavenly Dao" and can be used to directly identify heretics and kill them first and then report them]
"Su Wanqing is just sharing her cultivation experience, how can she talk about heresy?" Ling Wuwang clenched his fists, "You are clearly avenging a private revenge!"
"Public revenge?" Liu Yue sneered and raised his hand to throw out a file on the gates of the sect, "**The "Original Tiandao Lu" clearly records that 'the closed source of the exercises is the rule of heaven', but she insists on open source sharing. This is tampering with the way of heaven!"
The dossier fell to the ground, and the eight red characters on the front page "Those who close the source will live, those who open the source will die" are dazzling. Ling's mother was trembling with fear, and Ling Xiaomei tightly grabbed the corner of Ling Wuwang's clothes, "Brother Wuwang, Sister Su is a good person, we can't let her die!"
A scarlet prompt popped up on the system panel [Su Wanqing’s survival countdown is 71 hours and 58 minutes. The crime of heresy under the trial rules can directly deprive the cultivation base and extract the Tao fruit, which can be used to nourish the closed-source system of Tiandao Bank]
[Trigger a side mission to rescue Su Wanqing. The mission reward unlocks the resonance permission of divine blood and jade pendant. Failure punishment: the original rule carrier falls, and the progress of the Tiandao error correction task is cleared]
"Liu Yue, you dare to touch her!" Ling Wuhua used his spiritual power, and his fingertips glowed with a light golden halo, "I was the one who stole the secrets from the library, and I was the one who instigated the open source. It has nothing to do with her!"
"Oh?" A trace of evil flashed in Liu Yue's eyes, "It just so happens that you, a law-breaker without spiritual roots, should have died with her. But now, what I am looking for is Su Wanqing's accomplice - it is said that she has hidden half a volume of the manuscript of "Original Heavenly Dao Record"."
He waved his hand, and the inner disciples immediately gathered around him, "Search! Search carefully, and if you can't find the manuscript, take this old, weak, sick, and disabled person to the prison for torture!"
Ling Wuwang stood sideways in front of the door. The Eye of Rules had seen through the weaknesses of the four disciples' techniques. "Those who want to touch me must get through me first!"
Section 2: Visiting the prison at night, blood dreams hide secrets
Liu Yue and his party searched the residence to no avail and left angrily. Ling Wuwang settled down with his family and immediately sneaked into the sect's prison at night.
The heavenly prison is made of black-grained black iron, and the walls are engraved with "spiritual locking runes." You can feel the spiritual power being suppressed with every step you take. Ling Wuwang ran the Eye of Rules and quickly found the break point of the rune cycle. Injecting high-frequency spiritual power into his fingertips, the runes dimmed instantly.
[The Heavenly Prison Restriction Rule is detected. The energy of each incense rune circulates once, and the breakpoint lasts for 5 breaths. The southeast corner guard’s shift break is the only window for visiting]
He crouched and hid behind a stone pillar. He waited for the guard on duty to go away and then rushed to the cell where Su Wanqing was. Behind the iron bars, Su Wanqing was chained to her bones. Her white robe was soaked in blood, but her back remained straight.
"Wuwang, why are you here?" Su Wanqing's eyes flashed with surprise, and then turned to worry, "Liu Yue deliberately let you know, just to lure you to show up!"
"I know." Ling Wuwang held the cold iron bars, "I will definitely rescue you from the trial in three days. Where is the manuscript you hid? Liu Yue is looking for it."
Su Wanqing smiled bitterly and spat out a mouthful of blood. "The manuscript is on me, but they can't find it. This is no ordinary book. It was written with my blood. Only the breath of the spellbreaker can activate it."
She leaned closer to the iron bars and spoke in a very low voice, "I always have a recurring dream - when I was three years old, when I was about to starve to death in a mass grave, a drop of golden blood fell into my mouth., saved my life. The blood has the same runes as your Eye of Rules, and the word "Open Source" is also engraved on it. "
Ling Wuwang was shocked, remembering what the old beggar said about "divine blood turning into jade". Could it be that what was in Su Wanqing's body was the seventh author's divine blood?
"And this manuscript. "Su Wanqing took out a piece of animal skin scroll hidden close to her body from her collar and handed it to him through the iron fence, "I stole this from the inner library. It says on it, 'The seventh author killed himself and turned his divine blood into jade. When he meets the destined person, he wakes up, and when he meets the tamperer, he becomes angry'. "
At this moment, footsteps were heard in the distance. Su Wanqing hurriedly said, "Go quickly!" Liu Yue has set up a 'spirit-guiding array' outside the prison. As long as you use your spell-breaking ability, your position will be locked! "
Just as Ling Wuwang was about to turn around, two guards appeared at the corner, "Someone broke into the prison!" Get him! "
Section 3: The fragments hide the key, locking the murderous intention of the God Formation
Ling Wuwang turned sideways to avoid the guard's knife attack, and his fingertips hit the energy accumulation point in the opponent's Dantian, causing the guard to collapse on the spot. He took the opportunity to rush out of the prison, and Liu Yue's roar came from behind: "Ling Wuwang, you can't run away! In the trial three days later, I will let you watch with your own eyes as Su Wanqing is extracted from the Dao Fruit! "
Back at his residence, Ling Wuwang couldn't wait to unfold the animal skin roll. The Eye of Rules operated to the extreme, and the originally blurry handwriting gradually became clearer. In addition to what Su Wanqing mentioned, there was a line of small words covered in blood at the end: "The blood of the gods is the guide, and the jade pendant is the key. The two resonate, and we can get a glimpse of the original way of heaven." "
[Detecting the core clue that the divine blood in Su Wanqing's body is the key to activating the jade pendant, the "open source heart method" recorded in the manuscript can temporarily block the suppression of closed source rules]
【Warning! It has been detected that a "God Locking Formation" has been deployed at the trial site in Zongmen Square. This formation is specially designed to restrain lawbreakers. It can block rule-based abilities, and its continuous operation will extract the spiritual power of the target]
Ling Wuwang clenched the scroll of animal skin, already having a plan in mind. He must master the Kaiyuan Mind Technique, break through the Unlocking God Formation, and rescue Su Wanqing within three days.
"Brother Wuwang, I can help you. "Ling Xiaomei brought a bowl of hot water with a firm look in her eyes, "I heard from the old people in the handyman camp before that the eye of the Locking God Formation is under the flagpole in the center of the square, and it requires reverse spiritual power to destroy it. "
Ling Wuwang nodded and handed the animal skin scroll to her, "You take care of my mother for me. I will practice the Kaiyuan Mind Technique now. At noon on the third day, we should be together inside and outside. "
Just as he was about to get up, Meng Chun suddenly opened the door and came in with an anxious look on his face: "Brother Ling, it's not good! In order to prevent you from rescuing people, Liu Yue not only sent additional guards, but also invited Manager Li from Tiandao Bank to sit at the trial! "
Ling Wuwang's heart trembled. Guanshi Li is in the foundation-building stage and is proficient in the magic of phantoms. With him around, it becomes more difficult to save people. But he did not flinch, but his eyes brightened: "It's just the right time, I want to see if the closed source rules can block the power of open source. "
He sat cross-legged and circulated his spiritual power according to the Kaiyuan Heart Method on the animal skin scroll. Different from the Taoist closed-source method, the open source method emphasizes the sharing of spiritual power and cyclic symbiosis. It can absorb the surrounding spiritual energy of the world and the world at a speed three times that of the minimalist Qi-entraining method.
[It was detected that the protagonist was practicing the Kaiyuan Mind Technique, and his spiritual power broke through to the late stage of Qi Entrainment. The evolution of the Eye of Rules can temporarily block the suppression of closed-source rules, but each use consumes 1 year of Yangshou]
Three days later, in the early morning, Ling Wuwang opened his eyes, and his whole body was filled with spiritual energy. He hid the animal skin roll in his arms and said to Ling's mother and Ling Xiaomei, "Mom, little sister, wait for me to come back. "
Ling's mother grabbed him and gave him a peace charm, "Be careful. If you can't, just run away. Mom and my little sister are waiting for you." "
Ling Wuwang nodded, turned around and walked out of his residence. The sound of gongs was heard from the direction of Zongmen Square, and the trial was about to begin. He knew that this was not only a rescue, but also the first head-to-head confrontation between open source and closed source. Success or failure depended on this.
What he didn't know was that there was a tiny piece of paper hidden in the middle of the animal skin roll. On it were the words written in blood by Su Wanqing: "I dreamed..."You and I are both fragments of the original heaven. When we are together, we live, when we separate, we die. "
The system panel pops up the final prompt [crisis level at the trial site. Manager Li has laid a double trap, the God Locking Formation + Phantom Killing Formation. The divine blood in Su Wanqing's body has been marked by Tiandao Bank. Extracting the Dao Fruit can activate part of Mo Guizi's closed-source power]
